description: Search the Total CMS documentation. Returns matching pages with their path, title, group, and section headings. Use docs_get with a returned path to read the full page.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. "image resize twig" or "webhook automation"

name: docs_search

hint.description: Present when a search actually ran — guidance for the next call.

message.description: Present only when the query was too short (no token of 2+ characters). No `total`/`hint` alongside it.

total.description: Present when a search actually ran — total matches before the limit was applied.
